objective: lost revenue = sum over planned flights of revenue[flight] * (1 - operate[aircraft, flight])

aircraft.description: Aircraft assigned in the plan; only it can fly the flight
aircraft.label: assigned aircraft

arrival.description: Scheduled arrival time (a time before the departure means after midnight)
arrival.label: arrival time (minutes after midnight)

revenue.description: Ticket revenue lost if the flight is cancelled (0 = no booked itineraries)
revenue.label: ticket revenue

start_airport.description: Airport where the aircraft is at the start of the day
start_airport.label: start airport

end_airport.description: Airport where the aircraft must be at the end of the day
end_airport.label: end-of-day airport

capacity_share.description: Share of the normal day's departures (and, separately, arrivals) the airport can handle (0 = closed, 1 = no disruption)
capacity_share.label: share of normal capacity available

decision_variables.operate[aircraft, flight]: binary, 1 if the flight is operated (also on the aircraft's source and sink pseudo-flights)
decision_variables.connect[aircraft, flight, next_flight]: binary, 1 if the aircraft flies next_flight right after flight; arcs need same airport and arrival < next departure; 'source'/'sink' are the start/end of the day

constraints.leave_source[aircraft]: one connect arc leaves the source (a source -> sink arc means the aircraft stays idle)
constraints.reach_sink[aircraft]: one connect arc enters the sink
constraints.flow[aircraft, flight]: arcs out of the flight == arcs into it
constraints.fly_if_routed[aircraft, flight]: operate <= arcs out of the flight
